name: Optimal Projection Angle Selection via Mutual Information Minimization
definition: A method for selecting optimal projection angles in tomography by maximizing the joint entropy of projections, which is equivalent to minimizing the sum of pairwise mutual information (MI) terms to reduce the posterior entropy of the inferred 3D volume.
summary: This method selects tomographic projection angles by minimizing pairwise mutual information to reduce reconstruction uncertainty, distinguishing itself through efficient information-theoretic optimization rather than geometric or signal-to-noise criteria.
